text: `grep -nE '^## DEC-[0-9]+ — Provider facts used by a shared module' /mnt/vault/Portfolio/infra/remote-agents/decisions.md && ! grep -nE '^## BL-(044|045|048|050|052) ' /mnt/vault/Portfolio/infra/remote-agents/backlog.md`. Red until the decision exists and all five entries are gone.
why: The claim is about the vault's decisions.md and backlog.md, which sit outside this repository and cannot carry a break patch. The test ran green after the edits (DEC-122 found at line 8; none of BL-044/045/048/050/052 present). It was red before them: the register's newest entry was DEC-121, and the backlog held all five (24 entries, 19 after the removal, counted).
